purpose: IT-01 single registry: classify integration-tests surfaces and expose executable tiered selectors, prerequisites, assets and safety boundaries. Only suites wired to real containers/channels count as integration evidence; literal/simulated stubs stay disabled, while explicitly registered synthetic fixtures may run locally without counting as integration proof.

CONTAINER_GATED_REAL_INTEGRATION.meaning: extends AudioVideoContainerBase; IntegrationImagesCondition reports an honest skip when GH-90000 service images are absent

STUB_SCAFFOLD_DISABLED.meaning: literal-constant assertions, Map.of fixtures or simulated local calls with no real service/container/channel interaction; @Disabled until replaced by a wired suite — not evidence

SYNTHETIC_LOCAL_FIXTURE.meaning: explicitly runnable in-process synthetic workload; local fixture only, never real transport, codec, provider, host-capacity, or quality evidence

LOCAL_PROCESS_FIXTURE.meaning: bounded local child-process cleanup test; no Docker image or external service is required
